issues.description: Duplicate React imports in step-3/page.tsx — line 1 has a stale 'use client' + partial import from 'react' (useState, useEffect) followed immediately by the full import on line 3. This causes a compile error: 'useState is defined multiple times' and 'useEffect is defined multiple times', resulting in a 500 error on any route that triggers this module.
issues.root_cause: Two import statements from 'react' exist at the top of the file. Line 2: `import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'` is a leftover/duplicate of line 3: `import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react'`. The SWC compiler rejects duplicate named imports.

issues.description: React hydration errors on step-1 page — 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' repeated multiple times. Likely caused by dynamic/time-dependent content or particle animation canvas rendered differently on server vs client.
issues.root_cause: Some text or rendered output in apps/web/app/design/step-1/page.tsx differs between SSR and client render — commonly caused by Date.now(), Math.random(), or similar non-deterministic values used during render without suppressing hydration mismatch.

fixes.new_str:
"use client"
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
fixes.reason: Removes the duplicate partial React import that causes the SWC compile error 'useState/useEffect defined multiple times', fixing the 500 error on step-3 and the cascading Fast Refresh failures.
